source: WormWiring / Winding et al. 2023, Science 379:eadd9330 (doi:10.1126/science.add9330), larva network `fly_larva`
purpose: ledger of the larva connectome at the source's own cluster resolution, plus the coverage of the eight v2.28.0/v2.29.0 larva units over it
caveat: cluster is the SOURCE's inferred cluster index and is reproduced, not asserted; no cluster is given a function or a unit, and none was added to the library. Coverage means the endpoint's (cell_type, modality bucket) resolves to a larva profile at least one unit declares -- it does NOT mean the circuit's function is known. Left/right homology is counted as the source declares it, not verified. The eight unit_coverage rows are not additive: profiles are shared between units, so their sum exceeds `coverage.synapses_both_ends_covered` by the ratio recorded in `unit_attribution`.

network.unannotated_note: an edge touches the unannotated population whenever EITHER endpoint lacks an official annotation, so the synapse share exceeds the node share

coverage.defined: an endpoint is covered when its (cell_type, modality bucket) resolves to a larv.* profile that at least one larva unit declares as a member; a synapse is counted as covered only when BOTH endpoints are

cell_type_coverage.frontier_note: cell classes with no synapse on either side reaching a covered endpoint
cell_type_coverage.frontier_is_not_an_annotations_verdict: A class appearing here is outside every unit, which is a statement about the library's coverage and not about the reconstruction's annotation quality. MB-FFN is the clearest case: all 54 of its cells carry names like FFN-23. See annotation_identity for the two notions measured apart.

annotation_identity.note: `_unannotated` inside a larv.* profile id is the modality-recognition fallback, not an annotation verdict. A cell whose annotation is literally `KC` or `MBON-a1` carries no modality keyword, so it lands in that bucket while being fully annotated. Counts here read the `annotations` column itself. The ids are unchanged because they are load-bearing across the published artifacts.

unit_attribution.note: The eight unit rows are NOT additive. A profile declared by more than one unit (larv.lhn_unannotated and the other shared ones) makes a single synapse count toward each of them, which is correct but means the column sums above the covered total. Use `covered_total` for network coverage and the per-unit rows only to compare units with each other.
